text: {"voice": 4, "model_prose": 3, "fidelity": 5, "note": "The paragraph has the voice's apparatus (verse citations in parentheses, a colon-led schematic comparison, one long fact-to-fact paragraph, declarative verdicts like \"No one is made better by a flood\"), but its run of matched pairs (For Plato / For Genesis, Noah builds / Socrates derives, ark waiting / city waiting) and the tidy parallel close give it a balanced, model-like cadence, while every proposition is kept and nothing substantive is added."}
